question:
Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:

It remains unclear whether the board intends to implement the proposal (1)/ or if the statement was merely a strategic ploy (2)/ aimed at appeasing shareholders (3)/ in light of the recent legal setbacks. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The error lies in the construction of the phrase "**or if the statement was merely a strategic ploy**."
 
• The use of "**if**" is incorrect in this context. It should be replaced with "**whether**" to maintain parallelism with the earlier "**whether**" in the sentence.
 
• The corrected phrase should read: "**whether the statement was merely a strategic ploy**."
 
• This ensures proper grammatical structure and consistency in the sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"It remains unclear whether the board intends to implement the proposal or whether the statement was merely a strategic ploy aimed at appeasing shareholders in light of the recent legal setbacks."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Part 1: "It remains unclear whether the board intends to implement the proposal," **– This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 3: "aimed at appeasing shareholders,"** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
 
• **Part 4: "in light of the recent legal setbacks."** – This part of the sentence is grammatically correct and does not require any changes.
